summary: Oxyphenisatin Acetate was pulled from the market in the United States and 18 other countries starting in 1970 due to liver harm [3]. In a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a medium score of 59 for liver risk and a low score of 27 for heart risk [M]. Other similar drugs, including Oxyphenisatine, Triacetyldiphenolisatin, and Cyclofenil, were also removed from various countries because of liver harm [3][4][5].
